name: mod-mercenary
about: mods/mercenary: enlisting is locked without a level-20 hero of the class (forced with cheats), asks for confirmation, levels to 10; prestige ranks (49 Private, 50 Corporal); the mercenary data reaches the mission and the floor counts; the rank's bonus on the gold gain and experience multipliers (GetMaterialModifier, currStats.ExperienceMul); dying on the floor is a fall, announced; back in town the picker is forced open and the ledger lists the fallen. Then no script errors in our files. The cheat hit is sent six times: a single one left the paladin alive in 3 of 5 runs (block or dodge).

steps.name: a fresh level-1 paladin in town

steps.pattern: Reach level 20 with another Paladin first
steps.name: no level-20 paladin: enlisting is locked

steps.pattern: Type hwp merc enlist confirm to enlist
steps.name: asks for confirmation first

steps.pattern: mercenary Private, 49 prestige, next Corporal at 50.*\(now: gold gain x1\.15, experience x1\.15\)
steps.name: 49 prestige is still Private

steps.pattern: Rank gained: Corporal! \+30% gold and experience
steps.name: 50 prestige: Corporal

steps.pattern: Mercenary Corporal: if you die, it's permanent
steps.name: the mercenary data came along to the mission

steps.pattern: mercenary Corporal, 51 prestige.*; 51 floor\(s\).*\(now: gold gain x1\.30, experience x1\.30\)
steps.name: the first floor counted one prestige; Corporal's +30% is on the gold and experience multipliers pickups and kills use
dying on a floor is a fall

steps.pattern: \[HWP:mercenary\] fallen mercenary GameLab in town, opening the character picker

steps.name: a fallen mercenary cannot be played: the picker is up

steps.pattern: - GameLab, Corporal, level 10 Paladin, 51 prestige, fell in
steps.name: the ledger of the fallen lists it
